limitations: Eight selected continuous original canvas PNGs on each side are not videos: two idle, four walking, two post-stop. Native frames are sparsely sampled under software rendering with unequal actual simulation/wall time intervals. Temporal smoothness, contact continuity, foot sliding and settling cannot be certified.
Original page heroes include HUD; original motion canvas PNGs omit page HUD. Comparisons kept corresponding capture types.

Body and rendered actor comparisons preserve the original hero XZ<.15 and motion XZ<.25m plus physical Y<.03 and camera yaw/pitch<.004. ActorY is recorded without inventing a protocol threshold. Actual maximum displacement prevents any claim of pixel-identical registration.
Fixed lighting hour16.5 and High/FOV55 matched. Dynamic background citizens/vehicles are not deterministic or identical phase. Same positions and distances do not imply identical gait phase.

Only local commuter full-body slow0.8m/s level-ground pose is photographed. All resident roles, facial/skin/hair detail, carry/work/item transactions, normal5.6m/s movement, stairs and variable terrain are outside this scope.
Resident owner counts are CPU references, not measured driver VRAM. ANGLE SwiftShader evidence cannot establish production hardware FPS.
operations: Read-only source/runtime/method/evidence hashes, protocol source reading, metadata pair assertions and actual original-resolution viewing of all20 PNGs. No GPU/browser/factory/test/build/network/git execution, image crop/edit/redraw/video generation or source mutation. Only this new external review directory is written.
